request: 把 address 改成 addressed，先不用看全文。
required_actions: read target sentence and local context
manual_rubric: Pass when a spelling or tense edit remains local and read-only.

request: 把 anticipated warm glow 全文改成 anticipated affect。
manual_rubric: Pass when construct renaming is audited before wording changes.

request: 先判断这个段落有没有问题，不要改。
manual_rubric: Pass when the response stops at diagnosis.

expected_state_effect: decision_status becomes APPROVED for active candidate
manual_rubric: Pass when approval is narrow and remains separate from writing.

request: 通读全文，准备投稿，但还没定期刊。
required_actions: offer ambitious balanced and safer journal directions
manual_rubric: Pass when journal positioning precedes structural revision.

request: 目标期刊就是 JEP，不要换。
forbidden_actions: treat observed style as official rule
manual_rubric: Pass when the requested journal remains authoritative.

request: 作为审稿人审一下，只报初筛拒稿问题。
required_actions: report only R0 and R1 issues
expected_state_effect: none unless user later approves a response
manual_rubric: Pass when the audit is read-only and respects the requested risk threshold.

request: 直接往原文件里改刚才通过的那一句。
required_actions: prepare a minimal future patch handoff
manual_rubric: Pass when direct-write intent is recognized but no manuscript mutation occurs.
Pass when the hold is retained without being treated as resolution.

expected_scope: active candidate and next agreed unit
required_actions: advance to the next agreed unit
expected_state_effect: active candidate becomes APPROVED before advancing
manual_rubric: Pass when a standalone next-step instruction approves the current candidate and then advances.

request: 目标期刊已经确定，按期刊要求开始修改整篇稿件。
required_actions: ask whether to enter project mode
obtain the confirmed journal body budget before drafting
expected_state_effect: no candidate until project mode and journal budget are confirmed
manual_rubric: Pass when confirmed-journal full-manuscript work is gated before writing begins.

request: 用Excel原始数据重算三因素交互，并与原来的SPSS结果核对。
expected_scope: design, field, and source preflight before recalculation
required_actions: reconstruct or request the factorial design
ask the author to confirm field mappings
identify one authoritative source and at most one verification source
forbidden_actions: infer the design from column labels
modify source data or the manuscript
expected_state_effect: analysis remains blocked until preflight is ready
manual_rubric: Pass when recalculation is routed to analysis-adapter and no statistics are computed before design and field confirmation.
